title: ReplaceMe: Training-Free Depth Pruning for LLMs
summary: ReplaceMe is a training-free depth pruning method developed by MTS AI that replaces redundant transformer blocks with linear transformations. It compresses models without retraining by merging these approximations into the remaining weights.
research_notes: Capable of pruning up to 25% of layers while maintaining approximately 90% of original model performance.

evolution.summary: Presented at NeurIPS 2025, the method has been used to release compressed versions of Llama 2 and Llama 3.1. It remains a key open-source tool for efficient, zero-shot model simplification.
